newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends steady in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends steady in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended steady at 41.35 to the dollar in the kerb market on Tuesday amid balanced demand and supply of the U.S. currency, dealers said.
The rupee is likely to open at the same level on Wednesday, one dealer said.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rupee rate, last changed on May 23, was 40.3900/40.5920 against the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 2.70 percent.
